text:
Jesus did not come from the world of “the heavens.”
He came from the very depths of souls;
from where the self nests: from the inner
regions of the Spirit.


Why seek him above the clouds?
Clouds are not the throne of gods.
Why seek him in the burning stars?
They are flames like the sun that lights us,
orbs of inflamed gases… Only flames.
Why seek him on the planets?
They are globes like ours, lit
by a star around which they revolve.


Jesus came from where
the deepest thoughts
and the most remote instinct come.
He did not descend: he emerged from the endless
ocean of the subconscious;
he returned to it, and there he is, serene and pure.
He was and is a lion. Whoever ventures
boldly into the abyss
without shores of himself,
with the light of love, finds him.

translation.title: Jesus
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves Nervo’s interior account of Jesus and his emergence from the subconscious.
